name: Surface Labs
long_description:
Surface Labs helps B2B companies capture, qualify, and convert inbound leads through intelligent contact forms. We replace tools like HubSpot Forms, Zapier, and Chili Piper with a single platform that embeds on any site with one line of code.

Our AI agents handle lead capture, enrichment, routing, follow-up, and CRO testing — automating what used to require full marketing ops teams. Customers see a 30% lift in conversions in under 2 weeks, and our partial response capture feature collects 50% more emails from form drop-offs.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: Arjun and I met as freshman at UC Berkeley when we were assigned to be lab partners for our introductory electrical engineering class. We quickly became friends/ project partners/ roommates over the next several years. I always knew I would start a company someday, but didn’t know what problem to solve. After getting into YC with Arjun and going through a couple pivots, we finally decided to work on something we had first-hand experience with, and that’s what has led to our current intelligent forms idea.

launches.body:

Our AI Agents are already live in production, handling **50k+ leads every month**. \
\
Meet one of the first: the **Form Agent**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93874&key=user_uploads/1179226/4f068f22-c1da-43c6-a00a-132cea0b6259)

### **🙅‍♂️ Problem**

Marketing teams spend millions on ads, tools, and headcount… but still lose **30–50% of inbound leads** to spam, bad routing, and slow follow-ups.

Everyday reality:

* Endless spreadsheets and duct-taped workflows.
* Hours wasted fixing ops instead of building campaigns.
* Pressure from leadership while growth stalls and leads slip away.

Marketers weren’t hired to babysit forms and CRMs. They were hired to **create, inspire, and drive growth**.

### **👌 Solution: The AI Workforce for Marketing Ops**

We’re building an AI Workforce that handles the repetitive, manual parts of marketing ops so that marketers can focus on strategy and creativity. Here are some of the members of the Workforce:

* **Forms Agent** → builds high-converting funnels that capture every lead.
* **Follow-Up Agent** → responds instantly, with personalized outreach.
* **CRM Agent** → routes and updates deals in Salesforce/HubSpot.
* **Experiments Agent**→ runs CRO tests automatically to boost conversions.
* **Ads Agent** → optimizes ad spend and performance in real time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93874&key=user_uploads/1179226/d5785765-ad9a-4de4-a619-72393b38ca91)

### **📊 See Results within 2 weeks**

* **Agent-powered** inbound funnels boost conversions by 30%
* **80%+ spam eliminated;** replaces expensive ad fraud prevention & lead routing tools (e.g. ChiliPiper, LeanData)
* **Does the work of 3+ ops hires** at a fraction of the salary cost

### **Want to hire our agents (& get free lunch)?**

**👉 Stop letting leads slip away.** Book a demo/ free strategy call with our founders [**here**](https://calendly.com/surfacelabs/15-min-intro-call-with-surface)**.**

We’ll audit your inbound funnel/ ops and if we can’t build you a form + workflow funnel that beats your current setup, **lunch is on us.**

### **Want to work with us?**

[**_Surface Labs_**](https://withsurface.com/) _is an applied AI lab building the next generation of marketing technology._ _Our core product grew 70% in the last month, with 500k+ website visitor sessions and 50K+ leads captured every month. Surface AI agents are live in production and usage is 📈📈📈._

_Email [**saharsh@withsurface.com**](mailto:saharsh@withsurface.com) with 3 bullet points on why you want to work with us._

launches.body:
**TL;DR** We previously built intelligent forms for businesses to **_boost website conversions by up to 40%_**, but found them still struggling to close sales because they _couldn’t **scale manual human tasks**_ against increased lead volume. _We give every site visitor a dedicated AI agent to convert more leads into customers across the entire funnel._

# **The Problem.**

**Over 40% of ad spend is wasted.** Businesses spend money on ads to drive traffic to websites/ PPC pages, but businesses struggle to convert visitors into leads if the page fails to convey value and collect lead data. This results in **leads leaving to visit competitors' websites** and **wasted ad spend.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81386&key=user_uploads/1179226/f96972a0-9b96-420e-afcb-eb33ed6f4957)

Even if a lead does initially convert on the site, it’s not enough. Businesses still need to

* **filter out unqualified leads/ fake form fills**
* **decrease speed-to-lead**
* **repeatedly** **engage the lead**

This problem is most severe for businesses in **competitive ad spaces** with commoditized offerings (e.g. services, lending, higher education, home services, etc).

As a result, many businesses end up **buying low-quality leads in bulk** from lead gen services or just **spray-and-pray** cold outbound campaigns.

—

# **Our Solution.**

We’re building an **_intelligent lead management system_** — a better way to track and engage every lead that clicks on an ad & lands on your website.

We’ve achieved this by building:

* super customizable, **high-converting** lead forms
* dedicated AI agents to **qualify and engage every lead** on your website
* better **ad targeting and personalization** using first-party data collected on your website

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81386&key=user_uploads/1179226/c72a7f9c-8b56-47ab-8c8d-0eb0e222bb54)

The platform includes a highly customizable, multi-step form builder, agent configuration UI, and data + analytics dashboards that provide granular details for every lead.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81386&key=user_uploads/1179226/c8ca819f-6e77-44b7-ac87-a1629bcacc49)

—

## **The Backstory.**

We (**Arjun and Saharsh**) are both engineers who met at UC Berkeley 🐻 and have helped growth teams at multiple startups and companies like **Snowflake** ❄️ boost funnel conversion rates.

We launched our high-converting forms product last September, **booked 300+ customer calls** in just a few days, and have helped hundreds of businesses ranging from **law firms, real-estate** and **high-ticket coaching services** to **B2B SaaS companies** spending millions on ads boost conversion rates on their website.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81386&key=user_uploads/1179226/d96a94aa-8abd-4359-9bd8-6a4994841385)

Are you ready to optimize your ad spend and engage every lead using AI?

We’d love to chat! Reach out at [saharsh@withsurface.com](mailto:hello@plyhealth.com), fill out the contact form on our [website](https://withsurface.com/), or book a demo directly [here](https://calendly.com/surfacelabs/25-min-intro-call-w-surface-labs). We’d also appreciate sharing our launch and following us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/96129512)!

launches.title: 🏓 Surface: Intelligent Forms that Boost Conversions
launches.tagline: We're building a better way to buy products, starting with forms.
launches.body:
👋 Hey everyone - we’re Saharsh and Arjun from [Surface Labs](http://withsurface.com)!

### **🏆 TL;DR**

We’re building intelligent forms designed to help B2B companies collect richer customer data and convert more site visitors to customers via AI-powered content personalization.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74412&key=user_uploads/1179226/feb58565-fcf9-442d-9cd7-9a2b8cfbcd40)

### **🤔 The Problem**

**You’re losing out on the opportunity to collect valuable first-party data from your customers and increase conversions due to suboptimal forms on your landing page.**

* It’s difficult to personalize content on a form using existing solutions, despite this being one of the most effective methods for converting customers
* Solutions like Typeform don’t fit seamlessly into your product’s design/ styling and can look out of place 🤢
* HubSpot or custom-built forms can easily lack an optimal UX that drives form conversions 🥱

Optimizing page forms to collect rich user data that your marketing and sales teams can use to drive conversions is important but is an ongoing task that takes resources away from developing your core product.

### **✨ Our Product**

We’re building intelligent forms designed to help companies collect richer customer data and convert more site visitors to customers through AI-powered content personalization.\
\
Our forms can be embedded in minutes on your site as a pop-up or even take over the entire page and provide your business with a managed “Contact Sales” page!\
\
Here are some example of early forms that we’re building:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74412&key=user_uploads/1179226/f2cdf1f7-1166-4d67-8ffa-6008adac73c2)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74412&key=user_uploads/1179226/14aa7de7-73ea-43cb-986c-79b2bec5499c)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74412&key=user_uploads/1179226/6179b0ec-94eb-43d8-b97a-c93f33167b90)

Our platform has helped our customers:

* add targeted messaging to a form to easily enable personalization at scale
* reduce the burden of data entry for customers to improve form completions by up to 70%
* manage their entire inbound sales pipeline with our managed “Contact Sales” page experience
* enrich customer responses with external data sources and ask personalized follow-up questions that allow sales teams to instantly filter, qualify, and book meetings with leads

### **⚙️ Features**

At their most basic, our forms are customized to match your site’s theme and branding, but here are some additional things our forms can do:

* Intelligent form routing logic
* AI-Powered A/B testing of questions
* Automatic lead enrichment and scoring
* Slack bots that inform you when an important lead has signed up
* Integrations with your CRM, CDP, analytics, email, and scheduling tools

### 👏 **Our Team**

Arjun and I met as freshmen at UC Berkeley 🐻 where we both studied Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (EECS).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74412&key=user_uploads/1179226/3f2b4e0b-a5f2-438c-aa96-5b853b512322)

[Arjun](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arjun-sahai/) spent much of his time at Snowflake on the growth team optimizing their self-serve flow, starting with the form on [signup.snowflake.com](http://signup.snowflake.com).

[Saharsh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/saharshagrawal/) received his M.S. in EECS from Berkeley where he studied privacy-preserving systems and has worked at early-stage startups where he built products from 0-to-1.

They’ve both worked with marketing/ sales/ growth teams to perform experimentation around content personalization, onboarding flows, and form templates to help optimize improve response rates/conversion rates. After directly experiencing how powerful personalized business forms can be, Saharsh and Arjun decided to start Surface.

### **🙏 Asks**

If you are currently using a custom form/ Typeform/ Hubspot form, have had to disable your Calendly booking screen due to spam bookings, or are struggling to collect rich user data from inbound leads, check us out!

We’re onboarding a limited number of companies over the next 2 weeks and are custom-building forms for them prior to our self-serve product launch.\
Book time to chat with us [here](https://calendly.com/surfacelabs/15-min-intro-call-with-surface?month=2023-09) or reach out at [founders@withsurface.com](https://founders@withsurface.com)!

Visit our website at [withsurface.com](http://withsurface.com) to check out one of our forms!
